uncited: TSDF Volume Integration builds on [MeshIntegrator Integration](3630-meshintegrator-integration.md) to write a triangle mesh's truncated distance field into a `VoxelBlockGrid`'s `tsdf` and `weight` attributes [Parent].
The core data structure is `ScalableTSDFVolume`, which manages a `VoxelBlockGrid` with `tsdf` and `weight` attributes [Parent].
Each active voxel stores a float `tsdf` value clamped to $[-trunc, trunc]$ and a float `weight` value [Parent].
Fallback to computing from FoV: $f_x = w / (2.0 \tan(\text{FoV}_x / 2.0))$.
Try attributes in order: `extrinsics`, `w2c`, `inv(c2w)`, or construct from $R$ and $T$.
Voxels within the truncation band are overwritten (not blended), clamped to $\pm sdf\_trunc$ with `weight = 1`.
Voxels outside the band in those blocks get `tsdf = 0`, `weight = 0`.
Blocks outside the band are untouched [Parent].
